comment: Render presets. final = 1080x1920 native; draft = 540x960 upscaled. Measured on GitHub-hosted runners (private repo): ~76 s/frame final, ~19 s draft. Chunks of 12 frames keep each job well under its time limit. hd = 720x1280 native, upscaled to 1080x1920 (the blocky-diorama look; ~8 s/frame dev box, ~20 s expected on runners).
